description_full: Mega Fortune Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services to various industries. Its IoT integration solution includes consulting, development and implementation, analytics, and evolution. The company also provides IoT maintenance and support services; and business process outsourcing and technical consultant services. In addition, it trades in hardware and IoT-related products. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong. Mega Fortune Company Limited is a subsidiary of Mericorn Company Limited.

financial_summary: Mega Fortune Company Limited is a mid-cap technology business with a $2.1B market cap on $11M of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 11% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically. Gross margins of 51% confirm genuine pricing power.
Accruals are elevated at +74.7% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 0.6% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 77% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
